blockingIssues.description: Orb tap interruption pauses remote audio but does not reliably resume playback for subsequent utterances when the same subscribed LiveKit track is reused, leaving future agent speech silent.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Remove or narrow the off-limits ban on `page.tsx` LiveKit audio playback edits when milestone features explicitly require changes there.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Review of orb-stops-speaking flagged AGENTS.md mission boundary conflict: off-limits guidance forbids `page.tsx` audio pipeline edits while features.json requires such edits for the assigned UX fix.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Standardize Windows command examples and validator invocations to use PowerShell-compatible separators (`;`) instead of `&&` when shell context is PowerShell.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Review of no-event-listing-speech and current scrutiny run both encountered failures using `&&` and required retries with `;`; `.factory/services.yaml` includes `&&` command strings that fail in this environment.
